# Contributing

## Branching
- Long-lived: `main` (protected), `develop`
- Short-lived: `feat/*`, `fix/*`, `chore/*`, `docs/*`, `refactor/*`

## Conventional Commits
- `feat(scope): short description`
- `fix(scope): short description`
- `chore(scope): tooling/infra changes`
- `docs(scope): docs only`
- `refactor(scope): code restructure`

Examples:
- feat(iac): add vpc and subnets
- fix(ci): correct ECR login step
- chore(helm): bump chart version to 0.2.1
